# W1 source-aware unsupervised method-comparison report

**Validation type:** synthetic engineering control, not a source-level diplomatic result.
**Executed:** 8 October 2026; GitHub Actions run 37798500236.
**Code commit tested:** 028be3b42547e5ed8f8799adcb4b99d587d925d1.
**Runtime:** Node 22, Ubuntu GitHub Actions.
**Fixture:** invented text and 8-dimensional invented vectors generated by examples/synthetic_fixture.cjs; 25 inventoried records, 24 eligible, one explicitly unavailable, six simulated meetings. No actual MiniLM cache or UN text used.

## Fixed comparison: identical eligible source IDs and text hashes

| Model | Fit geometry | Existing clustering kernel | Eligible | Assigned | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| lexical-lsa-kmeans | Refitted TF-IDF / LSA (four components) | Ten-start k-means | 24 | 24 | Fitted |
| lexical-pca-pam | Refitted TF-IDF / PCA (four components) | PAM BUILD + SWAP | 24 | 24 | Fitted |
| lexical-lsa-ward | Refitted TF-IDF / LSA (four components) | Hierarchical Ward | 24 | 24 | Fitted |
| lexical-pca-gmm | Refitted TF-IDF / PCA (four components) | Regularized Gaussian EM | 24 | 24 | Fitted |
| synthetic-semantic-hdbscan | Invented vectors / PCA (four components) | Exact HDBSCAN* | 24 | 24 | Fitted |

Every model uses the same synthetic 24-observation ID/hash population. The four lexical methods yield the **same hard partition** after cluster-label permutation: six lexical-to-lexical contrasts each have ARI = 1 and AMI = 1. Each of the four lexical-to-invented-semantic contrasts has ARI = -0.016064257 and AMI = -0.049393418, calculated over 24 jointly assigned observations. Negative adjusted values are possible; they do not imply negative geopolitical alignment or a hypothesis test. The deliberately changed synthetic geometry produces discordant coassignments. The capped source-linked diagnostic returned 12 synthetic illustrative cases, **not** an exhaustive count of all disagreements.

This is a **positive adapter/metric control**: it shows that consistent source identities, changed geometry and permutation-invariant comparisons are handled. It does **not** test a real pinned MiniLM checkpoint or establish performance on diplomatic text.

## Resampling and non-delivery accounting

A common seeded plan (group seed 31415 by CLI default; tests also exercise seed 31) is used for 10 whole-meeting and 10 recorded-affiliation samples per model. The fixture contains six whole-meeting groups; the affiliation grouping respects transitive common parent/source-family membership and pools missing recorded affiliations as unknown. Source segments are never treated as independent bootstrap observations. The run reported five successful full fits and **zero skipped/failed full or grouped fits** in the completed synthetic comparison. No zero coverage was imputed to any source unavailable in the inventory. Group-level raw source membership and private evidence were not published.

Method-specific sensitivities include refit ARI/AMI, pairwise consistency and assignment-status agreement; GMM aligned conditional-responsibility variation; and HDBSCAN assigned-point strength variation. These summarize *computational stability under source-group omission*, not significance, confidence intervals, or independent diplomatic agreement.

## Independent metric references

Reference metrics were independently calculated using scikit-learn adjusted_rand_score and adjusted_mutual_info_score with arithmetic normalization, then hard-coded as fixtures in the Node test suite:

| Reference partition comparison | Expected ARI | Expected AMI |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Label-permuted identical three-group partition | 1 | 1 |
| Crossed three-way six-observation partition | 0.166666667 | 0.166666667 |
| Unequal contingency six-observation partition | 0.242424242 | 0.298792458 |
| Single-group vs two-group partition | 0 | 0 |

The tests also verify empty/no-cluster null metrics, noise-aware pair denominators, changed IDs/hashes, duplicate-heavy frames, source-group closure, missing attribution, no-variation refusal, insufficient independent groups, high noise, and intentional fit failures.

## Blockers and interpretation

1. The current coordinator namespace register reserves another W1 path and treats GitHub Actions workflows as coordinator-owned. This PR therefore needs a coordinator-approved exception or relocation **before merge**.
2. The coordinator's current v1 JSON Schema does not list `un.passage-frame.v1`, although its prose describes that upstream interface. The adapter **refuses to export** that source-schema value rather than mislabeling it; a coordinator schema extension or conversion via an already validated `un.passage-corpus.v1` source is required. Future real-data execution also requires a locally authorized development corpus and the verified pinned MiniLM cache. The package refuses absent or identity-mismatched caches; it does not access the sealed 37-meeting holdout.
3. No source-block exchangeability reference distribution, multiplicity control, significance testing, or claims about stance, national alignment or causality are implemented. These are explicitly withheld.

**Artifacts:** GitHub Actions run 37798500236, artifact w1-source-aware-synthetic-reports (14-day retention). Permanent source generator, tests, method guide and schema files are in this branch.
